test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

I did not even listen to him; he was only __talking through his hat.__
solution:
The Correct answer is **"****Talking nonsense**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Talking through your hat** is an idiomatic expression that means speaking without understanding what you’re talking about or making nonsensical statements. When someone is talking through their hat, they may be exaggerating their achievements or knowledge or simply bluffing. 

 
 
• **Example:** “I don’t believe Roy’s story about climbing Mount Everest; he’s talking through his hat!”
 
 
 
• **Talking nonsense** means to say things that are not reasonable or have no meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** Is it just me, or was she talking nonsense in the meeting?
 
 

Hence, the correct option is '**option 3**'.
